articles.title: Former project manager handling West Coast Town Council tenders gets jail for taking S$50,000 bribe

articles.title: Tamil Nadu: Karthigai Deepam festival begins at Thiruparankundram temple with traditional flag-hoisting ceremony
articles.description: The 10-day Karthigai Deepam festival at the Arulmigu Subramaniya Swamy Temple in Thiruparankundram Madurai commenced on Monday with the traditional flag-hoisting ceremony attended by hundreds of devotees Devotees gathered at the temple to offer prayers amid chants of Arogara marking the beginning of the annual celebrations As part of the rituals special abhishekam was performed for the presiding deities Lord Subramaniya Swamy and Goddess Deivanai at the Utsavar shrine using 16 sacred substances including milk sandalwood paste and tender coconut water

articles.title: Six New Vehicles for Chandrababu's Convoy at a Cost of Rs 1.78 Crore
articles.description: The Andhra Pradesh government has approved Rs. 1.78 crore to purchase six Force Urbania vehicles for Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu's security convoy. Each vehicle will cost around Rs. 29.67 lakh and will be purchased through the GeM portal. The approval comes after Chandrababu reduced his convoy from 12 vehicles to four in May to conserve fuel.
